plain: A secret scheme to harm or gain power

webster.text: The act of planning or contriving a scheme for executing some purpose, particularly an evil purpose; an artful design formed with deliberation.

example.quote: To be dangerous to the public safety—to be suspected of secret machination against the government; these can never be mistaken for legal rules or certain definitions.
example.cite: James Madison, Report on the Virginia Resolutions (Report of 1800), Jan. 7, 1800
